newsitem.title: USA: Kentucky First Bancorp sets $3.00/shr payout.
newsitem.headline: Kentucky First Bancorp sets $3.00/shr payout.

text.p: Kentucky First Bancorp Inc said Monday it has set a special cash distribution of $3.00 per share to shareholders of record on November 20.
The distribution is to be paid out on November 27.

The company said that based on an Internal Revenue Service ruling, it estimates that 98 percent of the distribution and dividends paid previously during the 1996 calendar year will not be considered taxable dividends.
Instead, they will be applied against and will reduce the shareholders' adjusted basis in the company's common stock, Kentucky First said.
The company said it will announce at a later date the precise percentage of the distribution and dividends to be non-taxable as soon as a final computation is made at the end of the calendar year.

"The board of directors believes that this distribution represents an excellent use of the company's excess capital that will benefit all of our shareholders," President and Chief Executive Betty Long said in a statement.
